summary: Wallowa-Whitman NF lookout site: frame cab from the 1930s, now gone; firelookout.com doubts it was used; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the frame cab is now gone; firelookout.com says it may never have been used; Oregon Forest Lookouts index lists it as Removed

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two register and index entries, with no staffing, fire, access or present-condition source. A web search on Wallowa-Whitman lookouts found nothing on this site. The 1930 event year is a decade placeholder. firelookout.com's 'may not have been used, possible proposed site' note sits against the register's 'now gone', which does not conflict but leaves the original cab's existence uncertain. The brief's 'ground' kind and the 2011 FFLOS registration match the register.
